rationale: PY-28 — an emitted edge whose SOURCE is not a symbol is an edge nothing can be traversed FROM, and it is the same class of defect as PY-4 (a keyword used as a scope name). Measured before the fix through the production path: 18 of 653 `references` edges on python-codesql (2.8%) and 60 of 1,252 on CPython's stdlib (4.8%) carried a source that binds to no symbol in the file — every one of them the NEAREST enclosing `function_definition` of a NESTED def, which the main walk deliberately does not publish (`if (ctx.currentFunction) break`). The forbid rows are the defect itself: each names a nested def that the pre-fix resolver published as a scope, and the harness fails if any of them appears as a `references` source. This is JOB 2's mandate — make every emitted edge resolvable — applied to the end of the edge nobody had audited, because `references` endpoints were never measured for resolution anywhere in this lane.
